title: Simon M.:
title_short: Simon M. · Anyone can play it
headline: Anyone can play it and you can play with anyone. For Simon it feels like a video game with friends, and it made math a lot more fun.
story: Simon is a 6th grader. His point is the simple one: the math is basic, so anyone can play, and you can play with anyone.
He liked math before, but never thought it could be fun. Math Hoops made it a lot better, and it feels like a video game with his friends.
Loops: L1 “Who can play?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:05. L2 “Did it change math for him?” opens at 0:12 and closes at 0:19. Stakes: math that never felt fun.
do: Open on “anyone can play it” with the hook text already on screen.
Cut to a wide of the full gym on “you can play with anyone”.
Cut “it feels it feels” to one “it feels”.
End on “a lot of fun doing it”, then the Donate end card.
dont: Do not use his intro (full name and school).
Do not cut “a lot a lot” on the last line if it sounds natural; trim it only if it sounds like a stumble.
No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No end-of-year campaign words on the end card.

-14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP peak. Music always under the voice.
Pauses inside a bite longer than 0.7 s are cut to about 0.25 s. Row times in this plan count that.

Two H.264 MP4s: 16:9 1920×1080 and 9:16 1080×1920. Upload to Frame.io, then Ready for Review.
checklist: Frame 1 is the speaker with the hook text already on screen. No logo, no name, no fade at 0:00.
